name: johns-site
_packageManagerComment: npm is the only package manager here, and package-lock.json is the only lockfile. The repo previously tracked all three of package-lock.json, yarn.lock, and pnpm-lock.yaml; they drifted, and pnpm-lock.yaml sat five weeks stale still resolving a dependency that had been removed. Declaring it here keeps a stray `yarn add` from reintroducing a second lockfile. Recover the deleted ones with `git show <sha>:yarn.lock` if ever needed.
_startComment: `npm start` previews the exported site, because `next start` cannot run here at all: output: "export" emits out/ and no server, so the old script only ever printed an error telling you to use serve. prestart builds first, so what you preview is always the bytes `npm run deploy` would push. serve matches GitHub Pages on the part that matters — a miss falls through to out/404.html with a real 404 status. Reach for `npm run dev` for day-to-day work; reach for this to check what only exists after export: trailingSlash routing, the 404 page, and the per-route OG cards. The port is pinned because serve falls back to a random high port when its default 3000 is taken, and 3000 is exactly where `next dev` already is — so the two run side by side and preview is always on 4000.

scripts.check: npm run verify:assets && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build
